NAME – Deprecated
Description
These commands allow you to resolve names using the DNS subsystem
configured on BIG-IP.
Command List
NAME::lookup
- Performs DNS query for A or
PTR record corresponding to a hostname or IP address
NAME::response
- Returns a list of
records received in response to a DNS query
Associated Events
NAME_RESOLVED
- Triggered after a
NAME::lookup
command has been issued and a
response has been received.
